commits.subject: Tag Guardian review counts with turn origin (#62225)
commits.reason: Count Guardian reviews by the issuing turn provenance while preserving review policy and bounded metric labels.
evidence: Reviewed the exact seven paths against 24e236514b. Binary diff SHA-256 0d8d411d11058fc278eadea913f27a3dc9ae8ecb1e20c6e266cce7f0a30cccbf.
The review captures the admitted turn trigger at report construction, including the trigger inherited by a delegated turn. Later steering has no effect on the captured label.
Only the count gains turn_origin. Known automation triggers coalesce to automation, missing or empty goes to unknown, and every remaining input goes to other. Raw client text is excluded from labels.

Source-declared controls only. guardian_metrics_distinguish_automation_main_and_subagent_turns checks actual turn propagation. review_report_bounds_turn_origin_on_both_verdicts covers bounded classification on both verdicts.
commits.revisit: Run the report labeling controls and actual root/delegated turn metrics fixture with account and review policy preserved.
